description: This file defines API endpoints for managing messages in a web application using FastAPI. It includes functions for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and processing messages, interacting with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM, and employs security dependencies for authorization.

methods.name: create_message(payload: MessageCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new message with 'pending' status, validates input and commits to the database.

methods.name: list_messages(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of all messages ordered by creation date.

methods.name: get_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific message by its UUID, raising a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: update_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, payload: MessageUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(require_roles("admin")))
methods.description: Update the status or JIRA issue ID of an existing message; restricted to admin roles.

methods.name: delete_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(require_roles("admin")))
methods.description: Delete a message by ID; restricted to admin roles, returns no content.

methods.name: process_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(require_roles("admin")))
methods.description: Run rule engine processing on a message, restricted to admin roles.
